item.text:
The login limit is in [U2FSignRequest](/app/lib/auth/auth.go:828): it returns as soon as it finds the first U2F device, so challenges are generated for only one token. Response verification already searches all registered devices by key handle in [checkU2F](/app/lib/auth/auth.go:2002).

A fix should return the requested `U2FAuthenticateChallenge` with a legacy single challenge and a `Challenges` list, then carry that type through the [auth client](/app/lib/auth/clt.go:1078) and [web session wrapper](/app/lib/web/sessions.go:488). [CLI login](/app/lib/client/weblogin.go:508) currently decodes and signs one challenge, although the underlying signer accepts multiple. The web sign request endpoint forwards the result; browser behavior remains uncertain because this checkout contains compiled web assets but no frontend source. [TestU2FLogin](/app/lib/web/apiserver_test.go:1387) covers one token, so coverage should include either registered token and both legacy and list payloads. MFA management is currently exposed through [tsh command registration](/app/tool/tsh/tsh.go:400).

I updated [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). I did not edit source or run tests: the fault-localization constraint for this pass explicitly prohibits source and test changes, so the requested fix remains unimplemented.
